 "data": "classDiagram
 direction TB

 class Auth {
 +String id
 +String token
 +String userId
 +String sessionId
 +DateTime expiresAt
 +DateTime createdAt
 +logIn(req, res)
 +logOut(req, res)
 +toRefreshToken(req, res)
 }

 class User {
 +String id
 +String name
 +String email
 +String phone
 +Geometry location
 +String pfpUrl
 +String passwordHash
 +String providerId
 +Role role
 +DateTime createdAt
 +DateTime updatedAt
 +Boolean isActive
 +register(req, res)
 +select(req, res)
 +update(req, res)
 +delete(req, res)
 +selectUserRecipe(req, res)
 +selectUserSaves(req, res)
 +registerUserInventory(req, res)
 +selectUserInventory(req, res)
 }

 class Recipe {
 +String id
 +String userId
 +String parentId
 +String title
 +String coverUrl
 +Json instructions
 +Decimal baseYield
 +String yieldUnit
 +RecipeStatus status
 +Int totalSaves
 +Int totalReviews
 +Decimal averageRating
 +Decimal profitMargin
 +Decimal overhead
 +Int prepTimeMinutes
 +Decimal hourlyLabor
 +Decimal packagingCost
 +DateTime createdAt
 +DateTime updatedAt
 +register(req, res)
 +selectSingle(req, res)
 +selectSingleUserInventory(req, res)
 +search(req, res)
 }

 class Ingredient {
 +String id
 +String parentId
 +String[] name
 +String description
 +String category
 +String creatorId
 +DateTime createdAt
 +register(req, res)
 +serach(req, res)
 }

 class Tag {
 +String id
 +String name
 +TagType type
 +DateTime createdAt
 +String creatorId
 +register(req, res)
 }

 class UserInventory {
 +String userId
 +String ingredientId
 +Decimal currentQuantity
 +String measurementUnit
 +Decimal packagePrice
 +Decimal packageSize
 +Decimal costUnit
 +DateTime lastUpdated
 }

 class UserSavedRecipe {
 +String userId
 +String recipeId
 +DateTime savedAt
 }

 class RecipeIngredient {
 +String recipeId
 +String ingredientId
 +Decimal baseQuantity
 +String measurementUnit
 +String notes
 }

 class RecipeReview {
 +String id
 +String userId
 +String recipeId
 +Int rating
 +DateTime createdAt
 +DateTime updatedAt
 }

 class UserTag {
 +String userId
 +String tagId
 }

 class RecipeTag {
 +String recipeId
 +String tagId
 }
